Precompile error codes and verify entrypoints for Ed25519, Secp256k1, and Secp256r1.

# Purpose
This header file declares the runtime entrypoints for three signature verification precompiles: [`fd_precompile_ed25519_verify`](<#fd_precompile_ed25519_verify>), [`fd_precompile_secp256k1_verify`](<#fd_precompile_secp256k1_verify>), and [`fd_precompile_secp256r1_verify`](<#fd_precompile_secp256r1_verify>). It includes the runtime and instruction context types needed by these functions and defines a small set of precompile error codes with fixed numeric values. The comment block explains that several distinct precompile errors are mapped to the same fatal error handling path to simplify fuzzing and because the exact error value does not affect consensus.
